title: dysphania × bontei
intro: Dysphania × bontei, commonly known as Bonté's pigweed or Bonté's bittercress, is a perennial plant belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dysphania × bontei include its ability to stimulate appetite, reduce nausea, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
